title: CSCI 250 — Concepts of Computer Systems
subject: Computer Systems
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the multilevel model of computer organization and explain how each level interfaces with the levels above and below it.
Explain the role of system calls, traps, and user/kernel mode transitions in managing privileged operations and resource access.
Apply the concepts of virtual memory, scheduling, and concurrency to analyze how operating systems manage multiple processes efficiently.
